title: How to continue TN5250 work safely
summary: Continue from v0.21 by learning host states before automating them, preserving one persistent session ownership, and tightening known remaining 5250 protocol semantics rather than adding ad-hoc PUB400 keystroke scripts.
invariants: New live host screens become immutable snapshot -> known-state candidate -> live-confirmed semantic state -> only then automation.
Prefer protocol/model correctness work over adding more one-off scripts.
Never widen raw credential, NONDISPLAY or live-host authority to make testing easier.
procedure: First reproduce the v0.21 fresh-package gate with exact external dependencies.
Then target unresolved 5250 semantics such as WRITE ERROR CODE pre/post-help behavior, help signaling and exact Read Immediate x72 wire regeneration.
Keep long-lived broker ownership as the default architecture for multi-agent interaction.

provenance.claim: Supports this Terminal Machine/TN5250 continuity article.
